newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 30.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.79 (-0.06)

The price of copper dropped almost US$100 a tonne in London in a sudden sell-off after it had seemed set on making a rally. News of a big decline in copper stocks failed to bring in enough buying to overcome selling at the higher prices. And the extent of selling led some traders to speculate that banks may still be unwinding a hoard of copper built up by Sumitomo Corp.
Burns Philp early on Wednesday posted a A$17.6 million net profit for the first quarter, up A$5.2 million on the same quarter a year earlier.
Rothmans Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a substantial improvement in profit for the six months to September 30, 1996 compared with the first half of the 1995/96 year.
RGC Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise US$150 million through a note issue, completing the group's refinancing. RGC is also due to hold its annual meeting in Sydney at 2.30 p.m.

Pioneer International Ltd is considering selling its 50 percent stake in Australia's largest petroleum refiner Ampol because of concerns over its profitability, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Mining contractor Eltin Ltd said late on Tuesday it will raise A$31.95 million by a one-for-four rights issue at A$2.20 per share to shareholders registered on November 12.
